Tartakiv Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Lviv Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Tartakiv's Jewish community, which predominantly followed Belz Hasidism, once made up more than three-quarters of the town's population — reaching 76.6 percent by 1921, among the highest concentrations recorded in this batch. A Jewish printing press operated here as early as 1740. The community was expelled to the Sokal ghetto in October 1942 and from there to the Belzec extermination camp; the cemetery itself, first documented only on 1939 military maps, is presumed demolished after the war though never built over.
